jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
 Visit in live here : W VERBIER Home

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

As a key member of the Whatever/Whenever team / Guest relations team , you are the behind-the-scenes force that ensures every guest experience runs seamlessly. From managing incoming calls to coordinating guest requests with precision, your role is all about logistics, anticipation, and operational excellence.
 You’ll be the central point of contact for guest needs—coordinating with all departments to ensure requests are fulfilled smoothly and proactively identifying opportunities to go above and beyond. Whether it’s a last-minute birthday surprise or a special arrival setup, you’ll have your finger on the pulse of what makes a stay unforgettable.
 This role requires a global understanding of hotel operations, strong multitasking abilities, and a natural flair for creating WOW moments—even from behind the scenes.
 You don't just react—you anticipate. You don't just complete tasks—you help shape experiences. All while embodying the Whatever/Whenever service philosophy that defines W Hotels

PROFILE
 • You are passionate about the W brand and are eager to be part of our team.
 • You have experience in Concierge/ Guest Service department in a high end, lifestyle kind of environment.
 • Fluent in French and English
 • You have a natural affinity to styling trends.
 • You have excellent people skills and have an upbeat, positive attitude to work and life.
 • You are creative and always think of new ways of doing things, you embrace change.
 • You are highly motivated
 • Be detail oriented and have a passion for giving guests an exceptional experience.
 • Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027
 Due to visa restrictions, only applications from Switzerland and the European Union will be considered

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Diventa un talente W e incarna l'arte W di vivere! Come ‘Talent’, siete l’essenza di W per i nostri ospiti. Porti un tocco giocoso, caldo e accogliente che fa la differenza nei nostri hotel W. Siete unici, appassionati e la vostra personalità brilla in ogni interazione. UN'ESCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITÀ PER IL TEAM VERBIER W! In qualità di membro chiave del team di relazioni con gli ospiti/qualsiasi squadra, sei la forza dietro le quinte che assicura che ogni esperienza degli ospiti funzioni senza soluzione di continuità. Dalla gestione delle chiamate in arrivo al coordinamento delle richieste degli ospiti con precisione, il vostro ruolo è tutto sulla logistica, l'anticipazione e l'eccellenza operativa. Sarete il punto centrale di contatto per le esigenze degli ospiti, coordinando con tutti i dipartimenti per garantire che le richieste siano soddisfatte senza problemi e proattivamente identificando le opportunità di andare oltre e oltre. Che si tratti di una sorpresa di compleanno dell'ultimo minuto o di una speciale configurazione di arrivo, avrai il dito sul polso di ciò che rende un soggiorno indimenticabile. Questo ruolo richiede una comprensione globale delle operazioni alberghiere, forti abilità multitasking, e un tocco naturale per creare momenti WOW, anche dietro le quinte. Non reagisci e ti aspetti. Non si completano solo i compiti: si aiutano a modellare le esperienze. Tutto pur incarnando la filosofia di servizio "Qualsiasi/qualsiasi" che definisce W Hotels ## Profilo Siete appassionati del marchio W e siete desiderosi di partecipare alla nostra squadra. Hai esperienza nel dipartimento Concierge/ Guest Service in un ambiente di alto livello, stile di vita. Fluente in francese e inglese Hai una naturale affinità con le tendenze dello styling. Hai ottime capacità di persone e hai un atteggiamento ottimista e positivo al lavoro e alla vita. Siete creativi e pensate sempre a nuovi modi di fare le cose, abbracciate il cambiamento. Sei molto motivato. Essere orientati al dettaglio e avere una passione per dare agli ospiti un'esperienza eccezionale. Interessi reali nei mondi del gusto, del suono, del corpo, della scena e della posizione ## Posizione da riempire per la stagione invernale: dicembre 2026 a marzo 2027 A causa delle restrizioni del visto, solo le domande della Svizzera e dell'Unione Europea saranno considerate ## Inclusività e diversità A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso all'opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile. La missione degli hotel è quella di accendere la curiosità, i mondi esplosi. Siamo un posto dove vivere la vita. Siamo qui per aprire porte e menti aperte. Siamo costantemente ispirati a nuovi volti e nuove esperienze. Uno spirito sintonizzato, up-for-anything è al nostro centro e ci ha resi noti per reinventare le norme del lusso in tutto il mondo. Qualunque sia la nostra cultura e la nostra filosofia di servizio che anima le passioni dei nostri ospiti. Se siete originali, innovativi e sempre alla ricerca del futuro di ciò che è possibile, benvenuti a W Hotels. Nell'unione di W Hotels, unisciti a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Devenez un W Talent et Embody le W Art de vivre! En tant que « Talent », vous êtes l'essence de W pour nos invités. Vous apportez une touche ludique, chaleureuse et accueillante qui fait toute la différence dans nos hôtels W. Vous êtes unique, passionné, et votre personnalité brille dans chaque interaction. UNE OPPORTUNITÉ EXCEPTIONNELLE DE PARTICIPER À L'ÉQUIPE W VERBIER ! En tant que membre clé de l'équipe Quoi qu'il en soit / l'équipe de relations avec les invités , vous êtes la force derrière les coulisses qui assure que chaque expérience des invités fonctionne parfaitement. De la gestion des appels entrants à la coordination des demandes des invités avec précision, votre rôle est tout au sujet de la logistique, l'anticipation et l'excellence opérationnelle. Vous serez le point de contact central pour les besoins des clients, en coordination avec tous les ministères afin de s'assurer que les demandes sont satisfaites en douceur et de façon proactive, en identifiant les possibilités d'aller au-delà. Que ce soit une surprise d'anniversaire de dernière minute ou une installation d'arrivée spéciale, vous aurez votre doigt sur le pouls de ce qui rend un séjour inoubliable. Ce rôle exige une compréhension globale des opérations hôtelières, de solides capacités de multitâche et un style naturel pour créer des moments WOW – même en coulisse. Vous ne réagissez pas, vous anticipez. Vous n'accomplissez pas seulement des tâches, vous aidez à façonner les expériences. Tout en incarnant la philosophie de service qui définit W Hotels ## Profilo Vous êtes passionné par la marque W et êtes impatient de faire partie de notre équipe. Vous avez une expérience dans le service Concierge / Guest Service dans un environnement haut de gamme, style de vie. Vous avez une affinité naturelle avec les tendances de style. Vous avez d'excellentes compétences humaines et avez une attitude positive et optimiste envers le travail et la vie. Vous êtes créatif et pensez toujours à de nouvelles façons de faire les choses, vous embrassez le changement. Vous êtes très motivé Être orienté vers le détail et avoir une passion pour donner aux invités une expérience exceptionnelle. Véritable intérêt pour les mondes du goût, du son, du corps, de la scène et de la position ## Posizione Position à remplir pour la saison d'hiver : décembre 2026 à mars 2027 En raison des restrictions de visa, seules les demandes de la Suisse et de l'Union européenne seront considérées ## Inclusività e diversità À Marriott International, nous nous engageons à être un employeur à égalité des chances, accueillant tous et offrant l'accès à des opportunités. Nous favorisons activement un environnement où les origines uniques de nos associés sont appréciées et célébrées. Notre plus grande force réside dans le riche mélange de culture, de talent et d'expériences de nos associés. Nous sommes attachés à la non-discrimination sur toute base protégée, y compris le handicap, le statut d'ancien combattant ou toute autre base protégée par la loi applicable. W Hotels est la mission d'Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. Nous sommes un endroit où vivre. Nous sommes ici pour ouvrir les portes et ouvrir les esprits. Nous sommes constamment inspirés par de nouveaux visages et de nouvelles expériences. Un esprit branché et haut de gamme est à notre cœur et nous a rendus réputés pour avoir réinventé les normes du luxe à travers le monde. Quoi qu'il en soit, notre philosophie de la culture et du service apporte à nos hôtes des passions. Si vous êtes original, innovant, et toujours regardant vers l'avenir de ce qui est possible, bienvenue à W Hotels. En rejoignant W Hotels, vous rejoignez un portefeuille de marques avec Marriott International. Soyez là où vous pouvez faire votre meilleur travail, commencer votre but, appartenir à une équipe mondiale incroyable, et devenir la meilleure version de vous.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

As a Welcome Ambassador / Bellboy , you will be the first point of contact for guests, offering a playful and genuine welcome. You will handle their vehicles and luggage, ensuring necessary transfers. Proactively manage requests and resolve complaints. Guarantee an exceptional guest experience by attending to their needs with meticulous attention to detail to create a Wow effect.

PROFILE
 • Passionate about the W brand with boundless creativity.
 • Previous experience in customer service and luxury hospitality.
 • Excellent interpersonal skills and fluent communication in French and English.
 • Highly motivated and dedicated.
 • Genuine interest in our brand values: taste, sound, scene, stance, and balance.
 • Attention to detail and a strong desire to provide a memorable guest experience.

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions, only applications from Switzerland and the European Union will be considered.

 • Previous experience in a 5* hotel reception area
 • Fluent in French and English, a 3rd language is appreciated
 • You are highly motivated

UNA OPPORTUNITÀ UNIca PER IL TEAM VERBIER W Come Rotating Serveur nei nostri ristoranti, accoglierai, servire e assistere i nostri ospiti con entusiasmo, professionalità e creatività, utilizzando tecniche di vendita appropriate. Come vero ambasciatore dell'esperienza W, aiuta a raggiungere gli obiettivi di servizio e assicurarsi che i tavoli siano impeccabilmente puliti e presentati. Potrai gestire le fatture e facilitare i pagamenti con precisione ed efficienza. Appassionato di ospitalità, crei esperienze memorabili e personalizzate per i nostri ospiti, seguendo i nostri standard e rispondendo alla guida del tuo Talent Coach. ## Profilo
• Esecuzione, dinamica, attenta ed empatica.
• Fluente in francese e inglese. La conoscenza delle lingue aggiuntive è un plus.
• Gode di lavorare in un team internazionale, innovativo e audace.
• Presentazione impeccabile, riflettendo l'immagine e i valori del marchio W.
• BAC PRO / CFC / BTS in Ospitalità o almeno 2 anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile.
• Motivato, orientato al dettaglio e impegnato a offrire un'esperienza eccezionale agli ospiti.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM

As a Rotating Serveur in our Brasserie 1519 & U-Yama sushi bar restaurants , you will welcome, serve and assist our guests with enthusiasm, professionalism, and creativity, while using appropriate sales techniques.

As a true ambassador of the W experience, you help achieve service objectives and ensure tables are impeccably clean and presented.

You will handle bills and facilitate payments accurately and efficiently.

Passionate about hospitality, you create memorable and personalized experiences for our guests, following our standards and responding to the guidance of your Talent Coach.

PROFILE

• Outgoing, dynamic, attentive, and empathetic.

• Fluent in French and English. Knowledge of additional languages is a plus.

• Enjoys working in an international, innovative, and bold team.

• Impeccable presentation, reflecting the image and values of the W brand.

• BAC PRO / CFC / BTS in Hospitality or at least 2 years of experience in a similar role.

• Motivated, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering an exceptional guest experience.

• Interest in the brand’s values: taste, sound, body, stage, and expression.

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions, only applications from Switzerland and the European Union will be considered

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

jobs.description:

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM

YOUR MISSION:

Take our guests on a journey through the enchanting world of the mountains—the magical story that inspires our signature bar. To offer far more than simple service, you must master this unique narrative and know our cocktail creations inside out. This expertise will allow you to immerse every guest in a mysterious, captivating atmosphere and turn each moment into an unforgettable memory.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Service & Enthusiasm:
 Take orders and serve drinks with a smile, professionalism, and charisma.

Experience Creator:
 Use sales techniques to elevate the guest experience by sharing the fascinating stories behind each of our signature cocktails, which change with every season.

Precision & Detail:
 Keep tables clean and ensure the perfect presentation of equipment and setup.

Reliability:
 Handle bills and payments smoothly and efficiently.

Passion for the Bar World:
 Show genuine interest in the universe of bars, spirits, flavors, and the emotions they can evoke.

Teamwork:
 Collaborate closely with your colleagues and respond quickly to requests from your Talent Coach.

If you are passionate about hospitality, storytelling, and the art of cocktails, this role is made for you.
 Become part of the legend. Make the moment vibrate. Be the experience. Be W.

PROFILE

Super motivated: Your energy and enthusiasm are contagious.

Passionate about Brand W: You share our values of taste, sound, scene, body and taking a stand.

Attention to Detail: You have meticulous attention to detail and love delivering a memorable customer experience.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Diventa un talente W e incarna l'arte W di vivere! Come ‘Talent’, siete l’essenza di W per i nostri ospiti. Porti un tocco giocoso, caldo e accogliente che fa la differenza nei nostri hotel W. Siete unici, appassionati e la vostra personalità brilla in ogni interazione. ## A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM ## Your MISSION: Porta i nostri ospiti in un viaggio attraverso l'incantevole mondo delle montagne—la magica storia che ispira la nostra firma bar. Per offrire un servizio molto più semplice, è necessario padroneggiare questa narrazione unica e conoscere le nostre creazioni cocktail all'interno. Questa esperienza vi permetterà di immergere ogni ospite in un'atmosfera misteriosa e accattivante e trasformare ogni momento in un ricordo indimenticabile. ## COSA DOVETE: ### Servizio & Enthusiasm: - Prendere ordini e servire bevande con un sorriso, professionalità e carisma. ### Experience Creator: - Utilizzare tecniche di vendita per elevare l'esperienza degli ospiti condividendo le storie affascinanti dietro ciascuno dei nostri cocktail firma, che cambiano con ogni stagione. ### Precision & Detail: - Mantenere i tavoli puliti e garantire la presentazione perfetta delle attrezzature e della configurazione. ### Affidabilità: - Maniglia bollette e pagamenti in modo fluido ed efficiente. ### Passion for the Bar World: - Mostra interesse autentico nell'universo dei bar, degli spiriti, dei sapori e delle emozioni che possono evocare. #### Teamwork: - Collabora a stretto contatto con i tuoi colleghi e rispondi rapidamente alle richieste del tuo Talent Coach. Se siete appassionati di ospitalità, storytelling, e l'arte dei cocktail, questo ruolo è fatto per voi. Diventa parte della leggenda. Fai il momento vibrante. Sii l'esperienza. Sii W. ## PROFILE - Super motivato: La tua energia e il tuo entusiasmo sono contagiosi. - Appassionato di Brand W: Condividi i nostri valori di gusto, suono, scena, corpo e prendendo posizione. - Attenzione al dettaglio: Hai una meticolosa attenzione ai dettagli e all'amore offrendo una memorabile esperienza del cliente. - Personalità in uscita e socievole: Sei allegro, un buon ascoltatore, disponibile e disponibile. - Fluenza nelle lingue: sei fluente in francese e inglese. - Spirito di squadra: Ti piace lavorare come parte di un team internazionale audace. - Presentazione impeccabile: Tu rappresenti l'immagine del marchio W con eleganza. - Istruzione ed esperienza: BAC PRO/CFC/BTS Catering o esperienza di 2 anni in un ruolo simile. Posizione da riempire per la stagione invernale: da dicembre 2026 a marzo 2027 Importante nota: A causa delle restrizioni del visto, saranno prese in considerazione solo le domande della Svizzera e dell'Unione Europea. Pronto a brillare a W Verbier? Unisciti a noi e porta il tuo tocco magico ad ogni colazione! 🌟 A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile. La missione degli hotel è quella di accendere la curiosità, i mondi esplosi. Siamo un posto dove vivere la vita. Siamo qui per aprire porte e menti aperte. Siamo costantemente ispirati a nuovi volti e nuove esperienze. Uno spirito sintonizzato, up-for-anything è al nostro centro e ci ha resi noti per reinventare le norme del lusso in tutto il mondo. Qualunque sia la nostra cultura e la nostra filosofia di servizio che anima le passioni dei nostri ospiti. Se siete originali, innovativi e sempre alla ricerca del futuro di ciò che è possibile, benvenuti a W Hotels. Nell'unione di W Hotels, unisciti a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

As a member of the HR department of the hotel, this role collaborates closely with HR colleagues. You will support the daily operations of the Human Resources Office, including recruitment and learning. You will be part of a team of four, enjoying a positive and collaborative work atmosphere. This position is committed to delivering high-quality HR services that drive business success while ensuring full compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.

As Talent & Training Assistant , you report directly to the Director of Human Ressources:

YOUR ROLE :

• Assist the Recruitment Manager throughout the recruitment process within the hotel (open & follow up on job requisition of the different channels)

• Provide support for internal training programs (Marriott training plateform and onboarding training from the W brand)

• Manage requests for extras (casual workers) from various departments and follow up on them (hours, payment …)

• Manage internal communications across the various communication channels and in-house

• Ensure that recruitment materials are kept up to date and that Marriott procedures are followed

• Manage a part of the staff accommodation (check-in/check-out inventory & follow up)

• You are responsible for apprentices and trainees at the hotel (Participation to the career fairs at hospitality schools, recruiting apprentices, follow up with the various organizations)

PROFILE :

• Previous experience in Human Resources

• Fluency in English and French; knowledge of other languages is an advantage

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build positive relationships with partners, managers and candidates

• Enjoy working in a bold, international team

• Excellent presentation skills that reflect the W brand image

• A genuine interest in the worlds of taste, sound, the body, the stage and taking a stand

Position to start on the 1st September 2026 for a long term contract
 Ready to take on this challenge and join the HR team? Join us and be part of an adventure where every detail counts

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

jobs.description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Voyage Global Leadership Development Program

Voyage: Training tomorrow’s leaders today
 Marriott International welcomes recent university graduates to experience the career development adventure of a lifetime and a world of leadership opportunities. Our global leadership development program, Voyage, propels participants on a mentored, learning-inspired journey to prepare you for a successful career. Voyage is a full-time, paid development program. As an associate and trainee, you’ll build upon the skills you developed in school by participating in real world assignments.

About the journey
 Voyage is an elite, award-winning program that provides a combination of hands-on, discipline-specific training and a leadership-focused curriculum. The program takes place at a Marriott International managed hotel, not a classroom, and is offered in 50+ countries. Voyage is available in the following disciplines:
 • Food & Beverage Operations
 Work Authorization (EU/Switzerland), Local Language Fluency
 When you join Voyage, you gain access to Marriott’s senior leaders and coaches and have many opportunities to stand out. You’ll participate in mini-rotations across the disciplines to learn firsthand how to manage various hotel functions and to connect with current and former Voyage participants through our social collaboration tools. Each individual’s Voyage journey is unique, spanning 12-18 months dependent upon your career interests, passions, goals, and location. You’ll immediately be immersed in our rich culture and portfolio of global brands to learn how Marriott sets the standard of industry excellence.

The experience you’ll gain
 Voyage participants learn by doing! You’ll be fully immersed in the day-to-day operations of a hotel. If accepted into this elite program, you will:
 • Cultivate customer relationships
 • Be a champion for innovation within the organization
 • Get exposure to managing projects & people
 • Improve processes & pitch new initiatives through your Voyage project
 • Take on special projects that will draw upon all your training

STELLENBESCHREIBUNG ## Das globale Leadership-Entwicklungsprogramm Voyage Voyage: Wir bilden heute die Führungskräfte von morgen aus Marriott International begrüßt frischgebackene Hochschulabsolventen, die das Karriereentwicklungsabenteuer ihres Lebens erleben und eine Welt voller Führungspositionen entdecken möchten. Unser globales Leadership-Entwicklungsprogramm Voyage begleitet Teilnehmer auf einer betreuten, lernorientierten Reise, um sie auf eine erfolgreiche Karriere vorzubereiten. Voyage ist ein Vollzeit-Entwicklungsprogramm mit Gehalt. Als Mitarbeiter und Trainee bauen Sie auf den in der Ausbildung erworbenen Fähigkeiten auf, indem Sie an praktischen
• Aufgaben teilnehmen. ## Über die Reise Voyage ist ein exklusives, preisgekröntes Programm, das praxisnahe, fachspezifische Schulungen mit einem führungsorientierten Lehrplan kombiniert. Das Programm findet in einem von Marriott International geführten Hotel statt – nicht im Klassenzimmer – und ist in über 50 Ländern verfügbar. Voyage ist in folgenden Fachbereichen verfügbar: - Food & Beverage Operations Arbeitserlaubnis (EU/Schweiz), fließende Sprachkenntnisse in der Landessprache Als Teilnehmer von Voyage erhalten Sie Zugang zu den leitenden Mitarbeitern und Coaches von Marriott und haben zahlreiche Möglichkeiten, sich hervorzutun. Sie absolvieren Mini-Rotationen in verschiedenen Fachbereichen, um praktische Erfahrungen im Management verschiedener Hotelabläufe zu sammeln, und vernetzen sich mit aktuellen und ehemaligen Voyage-Teilnehmern über unsere sozialen Kollaborationstools. Die individuelle Voyage-Reise ist einzigartig und dauert 12 bis 18 Monate, je nach Ihren beruflichen Interessen, Leidenschaften, Zielen und dem Standort. Sie werden unmittelbar in unsere vielfältige Unternehmenskultur und unser globales Markenportfolio eingebunden und lernen, wie Marriott den Standard für Branchenexzellenz setzt. ## Die Erfahrungen, die Sie sammeln werden Teilnehmer bei Voyage lernen durch Handeln! Sie sind vollständig in den täglichen Hotelbetrieb integriert. Wenn Sie in dieses exklusive Programm aufgenommen werden, können Sie: - Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen - Innovationen im Unternehmen vorantreiben - Erfahrungen in der Leitung von Projekten und Mitarbeitern sammeln - Prozesse verbessern und neue Initiativen über Ihr Voyage-Projekt vorschlagen - Spezielle Projekte übernehmen, die Ihr gesamtes Trainingswissen erfordern ## Ziel: Marriott-Führungskraft Sie nehmen an Management-Meetings teil und arbeiten weltweit mit anderen Voyage-Teilnehmern zusammen. Sie werden erwartungsgemäß Herausforderungen lösen sowie Ideen und innovative Lösungen einbringen. Außerdem haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Feedback zum Lehrplan zu geben und die Erfahrungen künftiger Voyage-Teilnehmer mitzugestalten. Nach Abschluss des Programms sind Sie bestens vorbereitet, Ihre Leidenschaft zu verfolgen und neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen. Viele Absolventen sind nach Abschluss des Programms sofort bereit, eine leitende oder einsteigende Managementposition bei Marriott zu übernehmen, da das Programm eine solide Grundlage für zukünftige Führungsrollen bietet. ## Bereit für die Reise? descriptionByLocale.en:
Supervisor Lenox Bar (m/f/d) Are you?
• Completed vocational training or hotel management school, or at least three years of practical work experience in the same or a related industry
• You have a structured approach to organization and enjoy communicating in German and English; handling sophisticated guest correspondence is essential. You creatively address guest concerns and implement new ideas with great interest and a keen sense of guest needs.
• Passion for high-quality beverages and excellent service
• Creativity and the ability to set new trends
• Our team is highly innovative and eager to experiment. If you also enjoy new things and challenges and approach them with curiosity and drive, you’ll be a perfect fit for our team Your Mission
• Ensure smooth service operations, guest care, and cash register reconciliation during your shift
• Inspire and motivate the team to perform at their best
• Enforce and meticulously uphold the hotel’s internal standards for guest care
• Create innovative and enticing beverages
• Ensure an unforgettable stay for our guests
• Handle guest complaints correctly in accordance with hotel standards Why Join Us
• A dynamic and young team of more than 200 talented individuals who know how to have fun while working
• In-house training
• An open and transparent corporate culture that prioritizes a passion for excellence, guest-centricity, and a spirit of innovation.
• Fair and accurate time tracking
• Solid benefits from an international hotel chain, such as employee rates at more than 9,000 hotels worldwide, free stays at the Zurich Marriott Hotel, and much more
• Enjoyment of work
• Room for creativity and personal development
• A permanent position that requires independence and personal responsibility
• You can expect a diverse role in a very lively and structured environment, a progressive and dynamic employee policy, and the benefits of an international hotel group. At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law. Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. As a host with Marriott Hotels, you will help keep the promise of “Wonderful Hospitality. Always.” by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With the name that’s synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you. JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you’re happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand’s namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Our hotels offer a work experience unlike any other, where you’ll be part of a community and enjoy true camaraderie with a diverse group of co-workers. JW creates opportunities for training, development, recognition and most importantly, a place where you can pursue your passions in a luxury environment with a focus on holistic well-being. Treating guests exceptionally starts with the way we take care of our associates. That’s The JW Treatment™. In joining JW Marriott, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

titleByLocale.fr: Agent de style (ménageur) (été + hiver) - W VERBIER

jobs.description:
W VERBIER
 Perched at 1,531 meters and located just steps away from Verbier’s main ski lifts, W Verbier offers immediate access to more than 400 kilometers of skiing, biking and hiking terrain. The iconic lifestyle W Escape has been voted Switzerland’s and World’s Best Ski Hotel at the prestigious World Ski Awards, eight years in a row.

Perched in the Swiss Alps at 1,531 meters with direct access to over 400 km of skiing and hiking terrain, W Verbier Retreat mixes urban design with an alpine touch. Our 5 star hotels 123 rooms and suites, each with fireplace, Signature W bed and private balcony are perfect for an intimate escape after a full day of exploring. Our luxury spa hotel offers a wide range of culinary options, including the Brasserie 1519, and the best mixology at W Living Room. Guests unwind in 1,300 sqm. of Alpine oasis at Le Spa featuring two pools, 9 treatment rooms, 24 hour FIT gym and facilities.
• We offer 245 square meters of flexible event space. Looking for more exclusivity, find our luxury residences, featuring 2 to 3 bedrooms, private kitchen, balconies and lounge spaces. The highlight is the easy access to all privileges and facilities of the Hotel right next door. From the W Mountain Concierge to the renowned and exclusive Whatever Whenever service, W Verbier team is there to make it happen

Visit in live here : W VERBIER Home

JOB DESCRIPTION

As "Talent", you represent W lifestyle to our guests. You are the soul behind the brand and you bring it to life. W Talents are as unique as the brand itself and are personally engaged from a lifestyle standpoint to the warm, witty, welcoming environment of the brand.

AN EXCITING CHANCE TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM

Style our Guests' W Experience.
 Clean guest rooms in accordance with established quality and performance standards to allow a sufficient quantity of vacant and clean guest rooms for sale.
 Clean occupied guest rooms.
 Clean and reset guest bedroom and bathroom areas according to established standards.
 Organize and stock cleaning cart and organize linen closets on floors assigned.

PROFILE

You have a prior experience in a 5* hotel in housekeeping.
 You are highly motivated
 Fluent in French and English
 Be detail oriented and have a passion for giving guests an exceptional experience.
 Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance
 Due to visa restrictions, only applications from Switzerland and the European Union will be considered

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
W VERBIER W VERBIER Arroccato a 1,531 metri e situato a pochi passi dai principali impianti di risalita di Verbier, W Verbier offre un accesso immediato a oltre 400 chilometri di piste da sci, mountain bike e trekking. L’iconico stile di vita W Escape è stato votato miglior sci Hotel della Svizzera e del Mondo ai prestigiosi World Ski Awards, otto anni di fila. Arroccato nelle Alpi svizzere a 1,531 metri con accesso diretto a oltre 400 km di piste da sci e da trekking, W Verbier Retreat mescola il design urbano con un tocco alpino. I nostri hotel 5 stelle 123 camere e suite, ognuna con camino, letto Signature W e balcone privato sono perfetti per una fuga intima dopo una giornata intera di esplorare. Il nostro hotel benessere di lusso offre una vasta gamma di opzioni culinarie, tra cui la Brasserie 1519, e la migliore mixologia al W Living Room. Gli ospiti si rilassano in 1.300 mq. di oasi alpina presso Le Spa con due piscine, 9 sale di trattamento, palestra FIT 24 ore e servizi.
• Offriamo 245 mq di spazio flessibile per eventi. Alla ricerca di una maggiore esclusività, trovate le nostre residenze di lusso, con 2 o 3 camere da letto, cucina privata, balconi e spazi lounge. Il punto culminante è il facile accesso a tutti i privilegi e le strutture dell'Hotel proprio accanto. Dal W Mountain Concierge al rinomato ed esclusivo servizio Qualunque sia, il team W Verbier è lì per farlo accadere. Visita in diretta qui: W VERBIER Home ## Descrizione - Come "Talent", rappresenti lo stile di vita W ai nostri ospiti. Sei l'anima dietro il marchio e lo porti alla vita. W Talents sono unici come il marchio stesso e sono personalmente impegnati da un punto di vista lifestyle al caldo, spiritoso, accogliente ambiente del marchio. - UN'ESCITAZIONE A JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM - Style our Guest' W Experience. - Camere pulite in conformità con standard di qualità e prestazioni stabiliti per consentire una quantità sufficiente di camere per gli ospiti vacanti e pulite in vendita. - Camere pulite occupate. - Pulire e reimpostare camere e bagni secondo gli standard stabiliti. - Organizzare e stock pulizia carrello e organizzare armadi di biancheria su pavimenti assegnati. ## Profilo - Hai un'esperienza precedente in un hotel 5* nella pulizia. - No. Sei altamente motivato - Fluente in francese e inglese - Essere orientato al dettaglio e avere una passione per dare agli ospiti un'esperienza eccezionale. - Interessi reali nei mondi del gusto, del suono, del corpo, della scena e della posizione - A causa delle restrizioni del visto, solo le domande della Svizzera e dell’Unione Europea saranno considerate ##
• Cosa offriamo W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. Siamo un posto dove vivere la vita. Siamo qui per aprire porte e menti aperte. Siamo costantemente ispirati a nuovi volti e nuove esperienze. Uno spirito sintonizzato, up-for-anything è al nostro centro e ci ha resi noti per reinventare le norme del lusso in tutto il mondo. Qualunque sia la nostra cultura e la nostra filosofia di servizio che anima le passioni dei nostri ospiti. Se siete originali, innovativi e sempre alla ricerca del futuro di ciò che è possibile, benvenuti a W Hotels. Nell'unione di W Hotels, unisciti a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi. ## Contatto (Nessuna informazione di contatto fornito)

jobs.title: Steward & Kitchen helper (Winter 26/27) - W VERBIER
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

We're looking for a Polyvalent Talent, as a Steward (50%) & Kitchen Helper (50%), highly motivated, enthusiastic and competent to rock the kitchen and stewarding! Teamwork doesn't scare you.

As a Kitchen Helper, you will assist your supervisors in the preparation of products for mise en place while respecting 5* standards.

We have a main kitchen for all our outlets: Brasserie 1519, Breakfast, W Living Room, In room Dining & Banquet.

As a Steward, cleaning products and tidying up the kitchen have no secrets for you: you will be responsible for maintaining the hygiene and cleanliness standards in the kitchen, the cleaning and storage areas for dishes, the cleaning of common areas, the cold rooms, etc.

You will be responsible for applying hygiene and safety standards and rules. You will also be responsible for maintaining the kitchen and B&F equipment.

PROFILE

Previous experience in stewarding & as a kitchen assistant, similar position

Knowledge of hygiene and cleanliness standards and products

Fluent in French and English/Spanish

You should be highly motivated.

Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance

Be detail oriented and have a passion for giving guests an exceptional experience.

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions only applicants from Switzerland and European Union can be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. jobs.description:
Build upon your classroom studies through our Hotel Internship Program opportunities. You will learn first-hand about a hotel's operations. Our Hotel Internship Program allows you to truly experience the industry from the ground up, where our founders and many of our leaders began. You will get immersed in Marriott's culture and business and find your true calling in the travel industry. Our internships are typically available in many different areas of the hotel. By gaining hands-on experience in the exciting world of hotel management, you�ll be better prepared to pursue opportunities post graduation. Here�s to exploring, kickstarting your dream career, and joining us on your journey!

To be considered for an internship, you must be a current college or university student. Want to join us? Apply now!

Marriott International is the world�s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. We believe a great career is a journey of discovery and exploration. So, we ask, where will your journey take you?

marriotthotelinternship

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.
 Run sold room reports, verify room status, determine discrepant rooms, prioritize room cleaning, and update status of departing guest rooms. Assist Housekeeping management in managing daily activities. Act as a liaison to coordinate the efforts of Housekeeping, Engineering, Front Office, and Laundry. Document and resolve issues with discrepant rooms with the Front Desk. Prepare and distribute room assignments to Housekeeping staff. Record, monitor, and update list of ‘Do Not Disturb' rooms. Ensure that vacant dirty rooms are cleaned by the necessary time and assign rush rooms and rooms previously on the ‘Do Not Disturb' list. Complete required Housekeeping paperwork.
 Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language; prepare and review written documents accurately and completely. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. As a host with Marriott Hotels, you will help keep the promise of “Wonderful Hospitality. Always.” by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With the name that’s synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
 JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you’re happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand’s namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Our hotels offer a work experience unlike any other, where you’ll be part of a community and enjoy true camaraderie with a diverse group of co-workers. JW creates opportunities for training, development, recognition and most importantly, a place where you can pursue your passions in a luxury environment with a focus on holistic well-being. Treating guests exceptionally starts with the way we take care of our associates. That’s The JW Treatment™. In joining JW Marriott, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

Mansioni - Eseguire i report sulle camere vendute, verificare lo stato delle camere, determinare le camere discordanti, dare priorità alla pulizia delle camere e aggiornare lo stato delle camere degli ospiti in partenza. - Assistere la gestione della Casa in attività quotidiane. - Agire da intermediario per coordinare gli sforzi tra Casa, Ingegneria, Ufficio Anteriore e Lavanderia. - Documentare e risolvere i problemi con le camere discordanti con la Reception. - Preparare e distribuire gli assegnamenti delle camere al personale di Casa. - Registrare, monitorare e aggiornare l'elenco delle camere "Non Disturbare". - Assicurarsi che le camere vuote sporche siano pulite entro il tempo necessario e assegnare le camere affrettate e le camere precedentemente sull'elenco "Non Disturbare". - Completare la documentazione obbligatoria per la Casa. - Seguire tutte le politiche e le procedure della società, di sicurezza e di sicurezza; segnalare eventuali problemi di manutenzione, pericoli per la sicurezza, incidenti o infortuni; completare la formazione e le certificazioni in materia di sicurezza. - Assicurarsi che l'uniforme e l'aspetto personale siano puliti e professionali; mantenere la riservatezza delle informazioni proprietarie; proteggere gli asset aziendali. - Accogliere e riconoscere tutti gli ospiti secondo gli standard aziendali; anticipare e soddisfare le esigenze di servizio degli ospiti; ringraziare gli ospiti con sincera gratitudine. - Garantire l'aderenza alle aspettative e agli standard di qualità. - Sviluppare e mantenere relazioni di lavoro positive con gli altri; supportare il team per raggiungere obiettivi comuni; ascoltare e rispondere in modo appropriato alle preoccupazioni degli altri dipendenti. - Parlare con gli altri utilizzando un linguaggio chiaro e professionale; preparare e rivedere documenti scritti in modo accurato e completo. - Inserire e localizzare informazioni relative al lavoro utilizzando i computer. - Stare in piedi, seduti o camminare per un periodo di tempo prolungato. - Muovere, sollevare, trasportare, spingere, tirare e posizionare oggetti del peso di meno o uguale a 10 libbre senza assistenza. - Eseguire altri ragionevoli compiti lavorativi richiesti dai supervisori. ##
• Requisiti - Essere uno studente universitario o universitario. ##
• Cosa offriamo - L'opportunità di costruire sulle tue conoscenze acquisite in classe attraverso il nostro programma di tirocinio alberghiero. - Imparerai di prima mano le operazioni di un hotel. - Il nostro programma di tirocinio alberghiero ti consente di vivere davvero l'industria dal basso verso l'alto, dove i nostri fondatori e molti dei nostri leader hanno iniziato. - Ti immergerai nella cultura e nel business di Marriott e troverai la tua vera vocazione nel settore dei viaggi. - I nostri tirocini sono generalmente disponibili in molte aree diverse dell'hotel. - Acquisendo esperienza pratica nel mondo entusiasmante della gestione alberghiera, sarai meglio preparato a cogliere le opportunità post-laurea. - Ecco a te esplorare, dare il via alla tua carriera dei sogni e unirti a noi nel tuo viaggio! ## Contatto Per essere presi in considerazione per un tirocinio, è necessario essere uno studente universitario o universitario. Vuoi unirti a noi?

descriptionByLocale.de: Bewerben Sie sich auf Ihre Klassenzimmer-Studien durch unsere Hotel Praktikumsprogramm Möglichkeiten. Sie werden zuerst über den Betrieb eines Hotels erfahren. Unser Hotel Internship Program ermöglicht es Ihnen, die Branche von Grund auf zu erleben, wo unsere Gründer und viele unserer Führer begannen. Sie werden in Marriotts Kultur und Geschäft eingetaucht und finden Ihren richtigen Ruf in der Reisebranche. Unsere Praktika sind in der Regel in vielen verschiedenen Bereichen des Hotels verfügbar. Durch die praktische Erfahrung in der spannenden Welt des Hotelmanagements werden Sie besser vorbereitet, um Chancen nach Abschluss zu verfolgen. Hier ist zu erkunden, Ihre Traumkarriere zu starten und uns auf Ihrer Reise zu begleiten! Um für ein Praktikum zu gelten, müssen Sie ein aktuelles College oder Universitätsstudent sein. Willst du mitkommen? Jetzt bewerben! Marriott International ist das weltweit größte Hotelunternehmen, mit mehr Marken, mehr Hotels und mehr Möglichkeiten für Mitarbeiter wachsen und erfolgreich. Wir glauben, dass eine große Karriere eine Reise von Entdeckung und Exploration ist. Also fragen wir, wo wird Ihre Reise Sie mitnehmen? marriotthotelintern Bei Marriott International widmen wir uns als Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit, begrüßen alle und bieten Zugang zur Gelegenheit. Wir fördern aktiv eine Umgebung, in der die einzigartigen Hintergründe unserer Mitarbeiter geschätzt und gefeiert werden. Unsere größte Stärke liegt in der reichen Mischung aus Kultur, Talent und Erfahrungen unserer Mitarbeiter. Wir verpflichten uns zur Nichtdiskriminierung auf jeder geschützten Grundlage, einschließlich Behinderung, veteranischer Status oder anderer durch geltendes Recht geschützter Grundlage. Bei mehr als 100 preisgekrönten Unterkünften weltweit schaffen die Ritz-Carlton Damen und Herren so außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse, dass die Erfahrung nach einem Gast bei uns bleibt. Anziehen der weltweit besten Gastfreundschaft Profis, die lebenslange Erinnerungen heilen, glauben wir, dass jeder Erfolg hat, wenn sie befähigt sind, kreativ, nachdenklich und mitfühlend zu sein. Jeden Tag setzen wir den Standard für den seltenen und besonderen Luxus-Service der Welt und stolz uns auf die Bereitstellung von Exzellenz in der Pflege und dem Komfort unserer Gäste. Ihre Aufgabe wird es sein, sicherzustellen, dass die „Goldstandards“ von The Ritz-Carlton jeden Tag gnädig und nachdenklich geliefert werden. Die Goldstandards sind die Grundlage von The Ritz-Carlton und sind das, was uns jeden Tag besser als der nächste führt. Es ist diese Grundlage und unser Glaube, dass unsere Kultur Erfolg treibt, durch die The Ritz-Carlton den Ruf als globaler Markenführer in der Luxus-Hospitalität verdient hat. Im Rahmen unseres Teams lernen und exemplifizieren Sie die Gold-Standards, wie unsere Employee Promise, Credo und unsere Service-Werte. Und unser Versprechen an Sie ist, dass wir die Chance bieten, stolz auf die Arbeit zu sein, mit der Sie arbeiten. Bei der Teilnahme an The Ritz-Carlton nehmen Sie mit Marriott International ein Portfolio an Marken bei. Seien Sie, wo Sie Ihre beste Arbeit tun können, beginnen Sie Ihren Zweck, gehören zu einem erstaunlichen globalen Team und werden die beste Version von Ihnen.
descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Profitez de vos études en classe grâce à notre programme de stages dans l'hôtel. Vous apprendrez directement les opérations d'un hôtel. Notre programme de stages hôteliers vous permet d'expérimenter l'industrie depuis le début, où nos fondateurs et beaucoup de nos leaders ont commencé. Vous vous plongerez dans la culture et les affaires de Marriott et trouverez votre véritable vocation dans l'industrie du voyage. Nos stages sont généralement disponibles dans de nombreuses zones de l'hôtel. En acquérant une expérience pratique dans le monde passionnant de la gestion hôtelière, vous serez mieux préparé à poursuivre des opportunités après l'obtention du diplôme. Ici à explorer, démarrer votre carrière de rêve, et nous rejoindre dans votre voyage! Pour être considéré pour un stage, vous devez être un étudiant collégial ou universitaire actuel. Tu veux te joindre à nous ? Présentez-vous ! Marriott International est la plus grande entreprise hôtelière du monde, avec plus de marques, plus d'hôtels et plus de possibilités pour les associés de croître et de réussir. Nous croyons qu'une grande carrière est un voyage de découverte et d'exploration. Alors, nous demandons, où va vous mener votre voyage ? marriotthotelinternat Chez Marriott International, nous nous engageons à être un employeur à égalité des chances, accueillant tous et offrant l'accès aux possibilités. Nous favorisons activement un environnement où les origines uniques de nos associés sont appréciées et célébrées. Notre plus grande force réside dans le riche mélange de culture, de talent et d'expériences de nos associés. Nous sommes attachés à la non-discrimination sur toute base protégée, y compris le handicap, le statut d'ancien combattant ou toute autre base protégée par la loi applicable. Dans plus de 100 établissements primés dans le monde entier, les Dames et Messieurs Ritz-Carlton créent des expériences si exceptionnelles qu'après qu'un invité reste avec nous, l'expérience reste avec eux. Attirer le monde des meilleurs professionnels de l'hôtellerie qui s'occupent des souvenirs de toute une vie, nous croyons que tout le monde réussit quand il est habilité à être créatif, réfléchi et compatissant. Chaque jour, nous établissons la norme pour un service de luxe rare et spécial dans le monde entier et nous sommes fiers d'offrir l'excellence dans le soin et le confort de nos clients. Votre rôle sera de veiller à ce que les normes d'or du Ritz-Carlton soient délivrées gracieusement et avec soin chaque jour. Les Standards d'or sont la fondation du Ritz-Carlton et sont ce qui nous guide chaque jour à être meilleurs que le suivant. C'est cette fondation et notre conviction que notre culture est à l'origine du succès grâce auquel The Ritz-Carlton a acquis la réputation de leader mondial de l'hospitalité de luxe. Dans le cadre de notre équipe, vous apprendrez et illustrerez les normes d'or, comme notre promesse d'employé, Credo et nos valeurs de service. Et notre promesse est que nous offrons la chance d'être fiers du travail que vous faites et avec qui vous travaillez. En rejoignant The Ritz-Carlton, vous rejoignez un portefeuille de marques avec Marriott International. Soyez là où vous pouvez faire votre meilleur travail, commencer votre objectif, appartenir à une équipe mondiale incroyable, et devenir la meilleure version de vous.

Description Développez vos études en classe grâce à nos opportunités de programme de stages en hôtel. Vous découvrirez directement le fonctionnement d'un hôtel. Notre programme de stages en hôtellerie vous permet de véritablement découvrir l'industrie depuis la base, là où nos fondateurs et nombre de nos dirigeants ont commencé. Vous serez immergé dans la culture et les activités de Marriott et découvrirez votre véritable vocation dans l'industrie du voyage. Nos stages sont généralement disponibles dans de nombreux domaines différents de l'hôtel. En acquérant une expérience pratique dans le monde passionnant de la gestion hôtelière, vous serez mieux préparé à saisir des opportunités après l'obtention de votre diplôme. À vous d'explorer, de démarrer la carrière de vos rêves et de nous rejoindre dans votre voyage ! Pour être considéré pour un stage, vous devez être actuellement étudiant au niveau collégial ou universitaire. Envie de nous rejoindre ? Postulez maintenant ! Marriott International est la plus grande société hôtelière au monde, avec plus de marques, plus d'hôtels et plus d'opportunités pour les associés de se développer et de réussir. Nous pensons qu'une grande carrière est un voyage de découverte et d'exploration. Alors, nous nous demandons : où votre voyage vous mènera-t-il ? marriotthotelinternship Chez Marriott International, nous nous engageons à être un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, en accueillant tous et en donnant accès aux opportunités. Nous favorisons activement un environnement où les antécédents uniques de nos associés sont valorisés et célébrés. Notre plus grande force réside dans le riche mélange de culture, de talent et d’expériences de nos associés. Nous nous engageons à ne faire aucune discrimination sur quelque motif que ce soit, y compris le handicap, le statut d'ancien combattant ou tout autre motif protégé par la loi applicable. ## Mansioni - Servir des plats et des boissons alcoolisées aux invités - Dresser les tables en fonction du type d'événement et des normes de service - Répondre aux questions sur les sélections de menu - Communiquer avec la cuisine concernant les questions de menu, la durée d'attente, les commandes de cuisson et la disponibilité des produits - Communiquer les exigences de repas supplémentaires, les allergies, les besoins alimentaires et les demandes spéciales à la cuisine - Enregistrer la transaction dans le système MICROS au moment de la commande - S'enregistrer auprès des invités pour assurer leur satisfaction avec chaque plat de nourriture et/ou boissons - Maintenir la propreté des zones de travail, de la porcelaine, verre, etc., tout au long de la journée - Effectuer les tâches de fermeture, y compris le réapprovisionnement des articles, l'extinction des lumières, etc. - Présenter un chèque physique et précis au client et traiter le paiement - Suivre toutes les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise et de la sûreté et de la sécurité ; signaler les accidents, les blessures et les conditions de travail dangereuses au gestionnaire ; - Assurer une apparence uniforme et personnelle propre et professionnelle, maintenir la confidentialité des informations exclusives et protéger les actifs de l'entreprise - Accueillir et saluer tous les invités conformément aux normes de l'entreprise, anticiper et répondre aux besoins de service des clients, aider les personnes handicapées et remercier les invités avec une véritable appréciation - Parler avec les autres en utilisant un langage clair et professionnel - Développer et entretenir des relations de travail positives avec les autres, soutenir l'équipe pour atteindre des objectifs communs, et écouter et répondre de manière appropriée aux préoccupations des autres employés - Assurer le respect des attentes et des normes de qualité - Lire et vérifier visuellement les informations dans une variété de formats (par exemple, petits caractères) - Se tenir debout, s'asseoir ou marcher pendant une période prolongée ou pendant un quart de travail complet - Déplacer, soulever, transporter, pousser, tirer et placer des objets pesant moins de 25 livres ou égaux à 25 livres sans assistance et des objets pesant plus de 50 livres avec assistance - Saisir, tourner et manipuler des objets de taille et de poids variables, nécessitant une motricité fine et une coordination œil-main - Se déplacer sur des surfaces en pente, inégales ou glissantes ainsi que monter et descendre des escaliers et/ou rampes de service - Passer au-dessus et au-dessous des genoux, y compris se pencher, se tordre, tirer et se baisser - Effectuer d'autres tâches raisonnables à la demande des superviseurs ##

jobs.description:
Build upon your classroom studies through our Hotel Internship Program opportunities. You will learn first-hand about a hotel's operations. Our Hotel Internship Program allows you to truly experience the industry from the ground up, where our founders and many of our leaders began. You will get immersed in Marriott's culture and business and find your true calling in the travel industry. Our internships are typically available in many different areas of the hotel. By gaining hands-on experience in the exciting world of hotel management, you�ll be better prepared to pursue opportunities post graduation. Here�s to exploring, kickstarting your dream career, and joining us on your journey!

To be considered for an internship, you must be a current college or university student. Want to join us? Apply now!

Marriott International is the world�s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. We believe a great career is a journey of discovery and exploration. So, we ask, where will your journey take you?

marriotthotelinternship

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.fr: Descrizione Profitez de vos études en classe grâce à notre programme de stages à l'hôtel. Vous apprendrez directement les opérations d'un hôtel. Nos stages sont généralement disponibles dans de nombreuses zones de l'hôtel. En acquérant une expérience pratique dans le monde passionnant de la gestion hôtelière, vous serez mieux préparé à poursuivre des opportunités après l'obtention du diplôme. Ici à explorer, démarrer votre carrière de rêve, et nous rejoindre dans votre voyage! Pour être considéré pour un stage, vous devez être un étudiant actuel du collège ou de l'université. Tu veux te joindre à nous ? Postulez ! Marriott International est la plus grande entreprise hôtelière au monde, avec plus de marques, plus d'hôtels et plus de possibilités pour les associés de croître et de réussir. Nous croyons qu'une grande carrière est un voyage de découverte et d'exploration. Alors, nous demandons, où va vous mener votre voyage ? marriotthotelinternat À Marriott International, nous nous engageons à être un employeur à égalité des chances, accueillant tous et offrant l'accès aux possibilités. Nous favorisons activement un environnement où les origines uniques de nos associés sont appréciées et célébrées. Notre plus grande force réside dans le riche mélange de culture, de talent et d'expériences de nos associés. Nous sommes attachés à la non-discrimination sur toute base protégée, y compris le handicap, le statut d'ancien combattant ou toute autre base protégée par la loi applicable. Dans plus de 100 établissements primés dans le monde entier, les Dames et Messieurs Ritz-Carlton créent des expériences si exceptionnelles qu'après qu'un invité reste avec nous, l'expérience reste avec eux. Attirer le monde des meilleurs professionnels de l'hôtellerie qui s'occupent des souvenirs de toute une vie, nous croyons que tout le monde réussit quand ils sont habilités à être créatifs, réfléchis et compatissants. descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione Costruire sui vostri studi di classe attraverso le nostre opportunità di Hotel Internship Program. Imparerete di prima mano sulle operazioni di un hotel. Il nostro Hotel Internship Program ti permette di sperimentare veramente l'industria da zero, dove i nostri fondatori e molti dei nostri leader hanno cominciato. Ti immergerai nella cultura e nel business di Marriott e troverai la tua vera vocazione nel settore dei viaggi. I nostri stage sono tipicamente disponibili in molte diverse aree dell'hotel. Guadagnando esperienza pratica nel mondo emozionante della gestione alberghiera, sarete meglio preparati a perseguire opportunità post laurea. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile. ## Mansioni - Controllare le figure, le postazioni e i documenti per una corretta entrata, precisione matematica e codici appropriati. - Organizzare, proteggere e mantenere tutti i file, record, contanti e equivalenti in contanti in conformità con le politiche e le procedure. - Registrare, memorizzare, accedere e/o analizzare informazioni finanziarie informatizzate. - Mantenere fogli di calcolo elettronici accurati per i dati finanziari e contabili. - Classificare, codificare e riassumere i dati numerici e finanziari per compilare e conservare i record finanziari, utilizzando riviste, registri e/o computer. - Preparare, mantenere e distribuire report e tabelle statistiche, finanziarie, contabili, auditing o payroll. - Procedure di chiusura e report completi di fine periodo come specificato. - Preparare, rivedere, riconciliare, emettere fatture, fatture e dichiarazioni di conto secondo le procedure aziendali. - Seguire tutte le politiche e le procedure aziendali; garantire l'aspetto uniforme e personale sono pulite e professionali; mantenere la riservatezza delle informazioni proprietarie; proteggere le attività aziendali; proteggere la privacy e la sicurezza degli ospiti e collaboratori. - Indirizzi le esigenze del servizio degli ospiti in modo professionale, positivo e tempestivo. - Parlare con gli altri usando la lingua chiara e professionale; preparare e rivedere i documenti scritti con precisione e completamente; rispondere ai telefoni e alle e-mail utilizzando l'etichetta appropriata. - Spostare, sollevare, trasportare, spingere, tirare e posizionare oggetti di peso inferiore o uguale a 10 libbre senza assistenza. - Sviluppare e mantenere rapporti di lavoro positivi con gli altri; team di supporto per raggiungere obiettivi comuni; ascoltare e rispondere adeguatamente alle preoccupazioni di altri dipendenti. - Esegui altri ragionevoli doveri di lavoro richiesti dai Supervisori. # Cosa# offrono Marriott Hotels si sforzano di elevare l'arte dell'ospitalità, innovando in ogni occasione mantenendo il comfort dell'oh-so-familiare in tutto il mondo. Come ospite di Marriott Hotels, vi aiuterà a mantenere la promessa di “ospitalità meravigliosa. Sempre.” fornendo un servizio pensieroso, sentito, in avanti che sostiene e costruisce su questo patrimonio vivente. Con il nome che è sinonimo di ospitalità in tutto il mondo, siamo orgogliosi di darvi il benvenuto per esplorare una carriera con Marriott Hotels. Entrando in Marriott Hotels, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi. JW Marriott fa parte del portafoglio di lusso di Marriott International e si compone di oltre 100 belle proprietà nelle città di gateway e località turistiche distintive in tutto il mondo. JW crede che i nostri associati vengano prima. Perché se sei felice, i nostri ospiti saranno felici. I soci JW Marriott sono fiduciosi, innovativi, genuini, intuitivi e portano avanti l’eredità dell’omonimo marchio e del fondatore della società, J.Willard Marriott. I nostri hotel offrono un'esperienza di lavoro a differenza di qualsiasi altro, dove sarete parte di una comunità e godere di vera camaraderie con un gruppo diversificato di collaboratori. JW crea opportunità di formazione, sviluppo, riconoscimento e, soprattutto, un luogo in cui è possibile perseguire le vostre passioni in un ambiente di lusso con un focus sul benessere olistico. Trattare gli ospiti eccezionalmente inizia con il modo in cui ci prendiamo cura dei nostri associati. Questo è il JW TreatmentTM. Nell'unione di JW Marriott, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Visit in live here : W VERBIER Home

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

The Welcome Agent & Spa therapist administers professional massage and body treatments to the guests. Must have thorough knowledge of numerous massage modalities, possess a general understanding of body treatments and be willing to train in a specific massage and body treatment offerings. Excellent communication skills. Ensure a high level of customer care to the guests.

A true chameleon of the spa and wellness world, you will carry out treatments booked by clients in a professional manner and according to the standards and protocols of the different brands, Dr Burgener & Esse : massages, facials & body treatments. You will attract customers' attention to the Spa and its facilities (Wet, Jacuzzi, hammam, sauna, FITness) thanks to your audacious welcome. You will encourage clients' curiosity about the Spa's treatments and a la carte products and position yourself as a salesperson. You will be responsible for greeting clients and making appointments in accordance with W Verbier standards; preparing the treatment room and keeping the Spa and rooms clean.

PROFILE
 • Outgoing, cheerful, sociable, good listener, helpful and available
 • Fluent in French and English
 • Enjoy working in an international and adventurous team
 • Excellent presentation and representative of the W brand image
 • BTS// CFC Esthetics/ cosmetics or equivalent
 • You have a prior experience in a 5* hotel
 • You are highly motivated
 • Be detail oriented and have a passion for giving guests an exceptional experience.
 • Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance

Position to be filled for the Summer season (June-September 2026) + Winter season (December 2026 to March 2027)

Due to visa restrictions only applicants from Switzerland and European Union can be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

La missione di W Hotels è quella di accendere la curiosità, i mondi esplosi. - Siamo un posto dove vivere la vita. - Siamo qui per aprire porte e menti aperte. - Siamo costantemente ispirati a nuovi volti e nuove esperienze. - Uno spirito sintonizzato, up-for-anything è al nostro centro e ci ha resi noti per reinventare le norme del lusso in tutto il mondo. - Qualunque sia la nostra cultura e la nostra filosofia di servizio che porta alla vita le passioni dei nostri ospiti. - Se siete originali, innovativi e sempre alla ricerca del futuro di ciò che è possibile, benvenuti a W Hotels. - Nell'unione di W Hotels, unisciti a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. - Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.
