Build upon your classroom studies through our Hotel Internship Program opportunities. You will learn first-hand about a hotel's operations. Our Hotel Internship Program allows you to truly experience the industry from the ground up, where our founders and many of our leaders began. You will get immersed in Marriott's culture and business and find your true calling in the travel industry. Our internships are typically available in many different areas of the hotel. By gaining hands-on experience in the exciting world of hotel management, you�ll be better prepared to pursue opportunities post graduation. Here�s to exploring, kickstarting your dream career, and joining us on your journey!

To be considered for an internship, you must be a current college or university student. Want to join us? Apply now!

Marriott International is the world�s largest hotel company, with more brands, more hotels and more opportunities for associates to grow and succeed. We believe a great career is a journey of discovery and exploration. So, we ask, where will your journey take you?

marriotthotelinternship

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

 As "Talent", you represent W lifestyle to our guests. You are the soul behind the brand and you bring it to life. W Talents are as unique as the brand itself and are personally engaged from a lifestyle standpoint to the warm, witty, welcoming environment of the brand.

AN EXCITING CHANCE TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM

Passionate bout the Art of Pastry and eager to grow in a prestigious environment? We are looking for our future Rockstar as a Pastry Intern!

As a Pastry Intern , you will assist our Pastry Chef in the preparation and setup of sweet creations for our various outlets, including Brasserie 159, Living Room, In-Room Dining, and Banquets. You will play an active role in the creation of refined desserts, ensuring they meet the high-quality standards of a 5-star establishment. Your role will also involve the strict application of hygiene and food safety standards, which are essential to maintaining the satisfaction of our discerning clientele.

You will evolve in an inspiring setting where high standards are combined with passion and the sharing of expertise.

This is your chance to contribute to unique culinary experiences that leave a lasting impression.

You are registered in a Pastry/Culinary school, with pastry specialization

You are highly motivated and eager to learn

Be a pastry student with a genuine interest in culinary excellence and haute gastronomy

A strong team spirit, a sense of organization, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic environment are essential.

Be detail oriented and have a passion for giving guests an exceptional experience.

Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance

If you are ready to take on this challenge and elevate your passion for pastry, join us and become part of an adventure where every detail matters.

jobs.description:

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Lifestyle!

As a "Talent," you are the embodiment of the W essence for our guests. You bring a playful, warm, and welcoming touch that sets W Hotels apart. Unique and passionate, your personality shines through every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

Your Mission as a Night Manager :

Night Guardian: You are responsible for the night shift, ensuring impeccable security and guest relations.

Key Contact: You are the go-to person for our guests, turning every complaint into a WOW experience.

Financial Maestro: Prepare the daily financial report and handle day-to-day accounting (validating invoices, processing payments, closing daily operations).

Reporting to Management: Communicate daily with management about your shift's progress.

Versatility: Assist different departments as needed.

Guest Check-ins and Check-outs: Ensure smooth and warm check-ins and check-outs.

Personalized Welcome: Greet guests at the reception or on the phone, inform them about hotel services, and encourage them to use these services.

PROFILE :

Experience: At least 2 years in the same role in luxury hospitality.

Outgoing Personality: Excellent interpersonal skills, adaptability, versatility, and motivation.

Languages: Perfect command of French and English; an additional language is a plus.

Technical Skills: Proficiency in Opera software.

Passionate about W: Genuine interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene, and stance.

Attention to Detail: You have a keen eye for detail and are passionate about delivering a memorable guest experience.

Position Available from August 2026 for long terme contract

Important Note: Due to visa restrictions, only applicants from Switzerland and the European Union will be considered.

jobs.description:
Perched at 1,531 meters and located just steps away from Verbier’s main ski lifts, W Verbier offers immediate access to more than 400 kilometers of skiing, biking and hiking terrain. The iconic lifestyle W Escape has been voted Switzerland’s and World’s Best Ski Hotel at the prestigious World Ski Awards, eight years in a row.

Perched in the Swiss Alps at 1,531 meters with direct access to over 400 km of skiing and hiking terrain, W Verbier Retreat mixes urban design with an alpine touch. Our 5 star hotels 123 rooms and suites, each with fireplace, Signature W bed and private balcony are perfect for an intimate escape after a full day of exploring. Our luxury spa hotel offers a wide range of culinary options, including the Brasserie 1519, and the best mixology at W Living Room. Guests unwind in 1,300 sqm. of Alpine oasis at Le Spa featuring two pools, 9 treatment rooms, 24 hour FIT gym and facilities.
• We offer 245 square meters of flexible event space. Looking for more exclusivity, find our luxury residences, featuring 2 to 3 bedrooms, private kitchen, balconies and lounge spaces. The highlight is the easy access to all privileges and facilities of the Hotel right next door. From the W Mountain Concierge to the renowned and exclusive Whatever Whenever service, W Verbier team is there to make it happen

Visit in live here : W VERBIER Home

Languages required: Fluent French & English

Role

As a Duty Manager & Quality, you play a central role in ensuring the smooth flow of daily operations and maintaining service excellence. You are present on the floor, especially during evening shifts with the Welcome Desk team, ensuring every guest interaction reflects the unique DNA and style of the W brand.

Main
• Responsibilities

Ensure quality and standards are applied (LQA & BSA)

Conduct regular Brand Standards audits and follow up on improvement points.

Ensure W and Marriott standards are consistently applied across all operational departments.

Oversee the maintenance and presentation of public areas and facilities to maintain a 5-star standard.

Guest satisfaction follow-up

Manage and analyze guest feedback via Marriott internal platforms (GXP, Medallia…).

Implement corrective and preventive actions to enhance the guest experience.

Welcome and assist VIP guests, ensuring a personalized and memorable service.

Resolve complaints and delicate situations with professionalism and a WOW mindset.

Training and team development

Identify operational improvement areas through audits and guest feedback.

Design and deliver targeted training sessions to strengthen team skills and service excellence.

Inspire teams to embody the W style and values in every interaction.

Operational support

Act as a liaison between departments to streamline communication and optimize operations.

Provide direct support to teams during peak periods or when needed.

• Profile

Bilingual in French and English, confident both spoken and written.

Proven experience in a similar position within upscale hospitality (4* or 5*).

Strong knowledge of Marriott & LQA standards is a major plus.

Excellent communication, diplomacy, and problem-solving skills.

Attention to detail, initiative, and a passion for guest service.

Ability to motivate and unite teams around shared goals.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

As "Talent", you represent W lifestyle to our guests. You are the soul behind the brand and you bring it to life. W Talents are as unique as the brand itself and are personally engaged from a lifestyle standpoint to the warm, witty, welcoming environment of the brand.

AN EXCITING CHANCE TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM

As Maitre d'hotel - Venue Supervisor (Morning & Evening) , you’ll support the Assistant Director of B&F in overseeing Breakfast, Banquets, and In-Room Dining during the morning and our Restaurants during the evening— ensuring that every detail reflects the elevated standards and original concept behind the W experience.

This is a hands-on, guest-facing position where your presence on the floor makes a real difference. From fine-tuning service flow to guiding and inspiring your team, your leadership will help shape a smooth, stylish, and unforgettable guest journey.

You'll be responsible for:
 • Coordinating daily operations across venues
 • Upholding grooming and service standards with precision
 • Coaching and supporting your team of Talents
 • Maintaining strong guest relationships and encouraging feedback
 • Contributing to the ongoing evolution of service excellence

YOUR PROFILE
 You’re someone who naturally combines refined service with fresh energy. You value structure and creativity in equal measure. People trust your judgment, respect your high standards, and are inspired by your calm leadership.
 You also bring:
 • Experience managing teams in a 5-star hotel or luxury hospitality environment
 • A sharp eye for detail — you don’t overlook the small things
 • A proactive, adaptable approach to change and daily challenges
 • Fluency in French and English
 • A genuine interest in aesthetics, service culture, and guest experience

GOOD TO KNOW

Based in W Verbier, Switzerland
 Please note: due to visa restrictions, we can only consider applications from Switzerland or the European Union

Position to be filled now, for a long term contract

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Operate and monitor washing, dry cleaning, and drying machinery, including adding chemicals and cleaning lint traps. Identify stained or damaged items and determine status for repair, spot treatment, rewash, or discard. Inspect cleanliness of articles removed from the washer, dryer, or dry-cleaning machines and place in clean linen carts. Set dryers to designated times and temperatures based on fabrics contained in load. Remove lint and debris from dryer screens, dry cleaning filters, and drain trap after each load. Fold cleaned articles into designated size, either by hand or using folding machine. Maintain accurate records of items laundered.

Follow all company safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards; identify, recommend, develop, and implement new ways to increase organizational efficiency, productivity, quality, safety, and/or cost-savings. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (e.g., to identify defects). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
 • Education: No high school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
 • Related Work Experience: No related work experience.
 • Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
 • License or Certification: None

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.  We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SUMMARIO POSIZIONE Operare e monitorare il lavaggio, la pulizia a secco e l'essiccazione di macchinari, tra cui l'aggiunta di sostanze chimiche e la pulizia trappole lint. Identificare oggetti macchiati o danneggiati e determinare lo stato per la riparazione, il trattamento spot, il lavaggio o scarto. Ispezione pulizia di articoli rimossi dalla lavatrice, asciugatrice, o asciugatrice e posto in carrelli di biancheria pulita. Impostare essiccatori a tempi e temperature designati in base a tessuti contenuti in carico. Rimuovere lint e detriti dagli schermi dell'asciugatrice, i filtri di pulizia a secco e la trappola di scarico dopo ogni carico. Piegare articoli puliti in dimensioni designate, sia a mano o utilizzando la macchina pieghevole. Mantenere registrazioni accurate di oggetti riciclati. Seguire tutte le politiche e le procedure di sicurezza e sicurezza dell'azienda; segnalare incidenti, lesioni e condizioni di lavoro non sicure al gestore; formazione completa e certificazioni di sicurezza. Seguire tutte le politiche e le procedure aziendali; garantire l'aspetto uniforme e personale sono puliti e professionali; mantenere la riservatezza delle informazioni proprietarie; proteggere le attività aziendali. Sviluppare e mantenere rapporti di lavoro positivi con gli altri; il team di supporto per raggiungere obiettivi comuni; ascoltare e rispondere adeguatamente alle preoccupazioni di altri dipendenti. Assicurare l'adesione alle aspettative e agli standard di qualità; identificare, consigliare, sviluppare e implementare nuovi modi per aumentare l'efficienza organizzativa, la produttività, la qualità, la sicurezza e/o i risparmi sui costi. Ispezionare visivamente strumenti, attrezzature o macchine (ad esempio, per identificare difetti). Stand, sit, o camminare per un lungo periodo di tempo o per un intero turno di lavoro. Spostare, sollevare, trasportare, spingere, tirare e posizionare oggetti di peso inferiore o uguale a 25 libbre senza assistenza. Passare attraverso spazi stretti, limitati o elevati. Spostare su superfici sloping, irregolari o scivolose, oltre a scale e/o rampe di servizio. Raggiungere la testa sopra e sotto le ginocchia, tra cui piegatura, torsione, tirando e poggiando. Eseguire altri ragionevoli compiti di lavoro come richiesto dai Supervisori. QUALIFICA PREFERRATA
• Istruzione: nessun diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente G.E.D.
• Esperienza di lavoro collegata: nessuna esperienza di lavoro correlata.
• Esperienza di supervisione: nessuna esperienza di supervisione.
• Licenza o Certificazione: Nessuno A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Set dryers to designated times and temperatures based on fabrics contained in load. Remove lint and debris from dryer screens, dry cleaning filters, and drain trap after each load. Fold cleaned articles into designated size, either by hand or using folding machine. Maintain accurate records of items laundered. Follow all company safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces. RÉSUMÉ DE LA POSITION Utiliser et surveiller les machines de lavage, de nettoyage à sec et de séchage, y compris l'ajout de produits chimiques et le nettoyage des pièges à peluche. Identifier les objets colorés ou endommagés et déterminer l'état de réparation, de traitement ponctuel, de lavage ou de rejet. Retirer la peluche et les débris des écrans de séchage, des filtres de nettoyage à sec et du piège à égoutter après chaque chargement. Pliez les articles nettoyés dans une taille désignée, soit à la main, soit à l'aide d'une machine pliante. Tenir des registres exacts des articles blanchis. Suivre toutes les politiques et procédures de sécurité de l'entreprise; signaler les accidents, les blessures et les conditions de travail dangereuses au gestionnaire; terminer la formation et les certifications en matière de sécurité. Suivre toutes les politiques et procédures de l'entreprise; veiller à ce que l'apparence personnelle et uniforme soit propre et professionnelle; maintenir la confidentialité des renseignements exclusifs; protéger les biens de l'entreprise. Établir et maintenir des relations de travail positives avec les autres; appuyer l'équipe pour atteindre des objectifs communs; écouter les préoccupations des autres employés et y répondre de façon appropriée. Déplacer, soulever, transporter, pousser, tirer et placer des objets pesant moins de 25 livres sans assistance. Se déplacer dans des espaces étroits, confinés ou surélevés. Déplacez-vous sur des surfaces inclinées, inégales ou glissantes, ainsi que sur des escaliers et/ou des rampes de service. Atteindre au-dessus et au-dessous des genoux, y compris la flexion, la torsion, la traction et l'inclinaison. Exécuter d'autres tâches raisonnables à la demande des superviseurs. jobs.description:
WORKING IN SWITZERLAND
 Swiss B or C permit OR EU citizenship

LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS
 Good level of German and English are required

POSITION SUMMARY

Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues with little to no supervision. Perform preventive maintenance on tools and equipment, including cleaning and lubrication. Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines. Carry equipment (e.g., tools, radio). Identify, locate, and operate all shut-off valves for equipment. Maintain maintenance inventory and requisition parts and supplies as needed. Assure each day’s activities and problems that occur are communicated to the other shifts using approved communication programs and standards. Display advanced ability to read standard blue prints and electrical schematics concerning plumbing and HVAC. Display above average engineering operations skills and strong general mechanical ability. Display proficiency in at least three of the following categories, above average skills in three more of the following categories and basic skills in the remaining categories: air conditioning and refrigeration, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, pneumatic/electronic systems and controls, carpentry and finish skills, kitchen equipment, vehicles, energy conservation, and/or general building management. Display solid knowledge and skill in the safe use of hand and power tools and other materials required to perform repair and maintenance tasks. Safely perform highly complex repairs of the physical property, electrical, plumbing and mechanical equipment, air conditioners, refrigeration and pool heaters - ensuring all methods, materials and practices meet company standards and Local and National codes - with little or no supervision. Troubleshoot and perform repairs on all types of equipment (e.g., pump and motor replacement), plumbing (e.g., plunge toilets and unclog drains), electrical equipment including lamps, air conditioners, HVAC equipment, cosmetic items, extension cords, vacuum cleaners, internet devices, replace electrical switches and outlets, and program TV's. Use the Lockout/Tagout system before performing any maintenance work. Display advanced knowledge of all engineering computer programs related to preventative maintenance, energy management, and other systems, including devices that interact with such programs. Perform advanced troubleshooting of hotel Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems. Display the ability to train and mentor other engineers as necessary. Display ability to perform Engineer on Duty responsibilities, including readings and rounds.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials. Ensure uniform and personal appearances are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Adhere to quality expectations and standards. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. Move up and down stairs, service ramps, and/or ladders. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Enter and locate work-related information using computers. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
 • Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent and vocational or technical background.
 • Related Work Experience: Extensive experience and training in general maintenance, electrical or refrigeration, parts inventory and requisition, exterior and interior surface preparation and painting.
 • At least 2 years of hotel engineering/maintenance experience.
 • Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
 • License or Certification: Valid Driver’s License

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
 • Universal Chlorofluorocarbon (CFC) Certification
 • Must meet applicable state and federal certification and/or licensing

• Requisiti linguistici - Buon livello di tedesco e inglese richiesti ## Mansioni - Rispondere e occuparsi delle richieste di riparazione dei clienti - Comunicare con i clienti/utenti per risolvere problemi di manutenzione con poca o nessuna supervisione - Eseguire manutenzione preventiva su strumenti e attrezzature, compresa pulizia e lubrificazione - Ispezionare visivamente strumenti, attrezzature o macchine - Trasportare attrezzature (ad es. strumenti, radio) - Identificare, localizzare e azionare tutte le valvole di chiusura per le attrezzature - Mantenere l'inventario di manutenzione e richiedere parti e forniture secondo necessità - Assicurarsi che le attività del giorno e i problemi che si verificano siano comunicati agli altri turni utilizzando programmi e standard di comunicazione approvati - Mostrare avanzata capacità di leggere standard blue prints e schemi elettrici relativi a idraulica e HVAC - Mostrare abilità operative avanzate e forti abilità meccaniche generali - Mostrare competenza in almeno tre delle seguenti categorie, abilità avanzate in altre tre delle seguenti categorie e abilità di base nelle categorie rimanenti: condizionamento d'aria e refrigerazione, elettricità, meccanica, idraulica, sistemi pneumatici/elettronici e controlli, falegnameria e finitura, attrezzature da cucina, veicoli, conservazione dell'energia e/o gestione generale degli edifici - Mostrare solida conoscenza e abilità nell'uso sicuro di strumenti manuali e elettrici e altri materiali richiesti per eseguire riparazioni e compiti di manutenzione - Eseguire in modo sicuro riparazioni altamente complesse della proprietà fisica, attrezzature elettriche, idrauliche e meccaniche, condizionatori d'aria, refrigerazione e riscaldatori per piscine - assicurandosi che tutti i metodi, materiali e pratiche soddisfino gli standard dell'azienda e i codici locali e nazionali - con poca o nessuna supervisione - Risolvere problemi e eseguire riparazioni su tutti i tipi di attrezzature (ad es. sostituzione di pompe e motori), idraulica (ad es. pulire i WC e sbloccare i drenaggi), attrezzature elettriche compresi lampade, condizionatori d'aria, attrezzature HVAC, articoli cosmetici, cavi di prolunga, aspirapolvere, dispositivi Internet, sostituire interruttori e prese elettriche e programmare TV - Utilizzare il sistema Lockout/Tagout prima di eseguire qualsiasi lavoro di manutenzione - Mostrare avanzata conoscenza di tutti i programmi informatici di ingegneria relativi alla manutenzione preventiva, alla gestione dell'energia e ad altri sistemi, compresi dispositivi che interagiscono con tali programmi - Eseguire avanzata risoluzione dei problemi dei sistemi MEP (meccanici, elettrici e idraulici) dell'hotel - Mostrare la capacità di formare e guidare altri ingegneri secondo necessità - Mostrare la capacità di eseguire compiti di ingegnere di servizio, comprese letture e giri ##
• Requisiti - Seguire tutte le politiche e procedure di sicurezza e protezione dell'azienda; segnalare eventuali problemi di manutenzione, pericoli per la sicurezza, incidenti o infortuni; completare la formazione e le certificazioni di sicurezza; e conservare correttamente materiali infiammabili - Assicurarsi che l'uniforme e l'aspetto personale siano puliti e professionali, mantenere la riservatezza delle informazioni proprietarie e proteggere le risorse dell'azienda - Accogliere e riconoscere tutti i clienti secondo gli standard dell'azienda, anticipare e affrontare le esigenze dei clienti, assistere le persone con disabilità e ringraziare i clienti con genuina apprezzamento - Aderire alle aspettative e agli standard di qualità - Sviluppare e mantenere relazioni di lavoro positive con altri, supportare il team per raggiungere obiettivi comuni e ascoltare e rispondere in modo appropriato alle preoccupazioni degli altri dipendenti - Parlare con altri usando un linguaggio chiaro e professionale - Muoversi, sollevare, trasportare, spingere, tirare e collocare oggetti del peso di meno o uguale a 50 libbre senza assistenza e compiti di sollevamento o movimento più pesanti con assistenza - Salire e scendere scale, rampe di servizio e/o scale - Raggiungere sopra la testa e sotto le ginocchia, compresi piegarsi, torcersi, tirare e chinarsi - Inserire e localizzare informazioni relative al lavoro usando computer - Eseguire altri compiti ragionevoli richiesti dal lavoro ## Qualifiche preferite - Istruzione: diploma di scuola superiore o equivalente G.E.D. e esperienza professionale o tecnica - Esperienza lavorativa: esperienza estensiva e formazione in manutenzione generale, elettricità o refrigerazione, inventario di parti e richiesta, preparazione e pittura di superfici esterne e interne - Almeno 2 anni di esperienza in ingegneria/manutenção alberghiera - Esperienza di supervisione: nessuna esperienza di supervisione - Licenza o certificazione: patente di guida valida ## Qualifiche richieste - Certificazione universale per clorofluorocarburi (CFC) - Deve soddisfare i requisiti di certificazione e/o licenza applicabili a livello statale e federale ##
• Cosa offriamo - Marriott International si impegna a essere un datore di lavoro che offre pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo accesso all'opportunità - Creiamo un ambiente in cui i background unici dei nostri associati sono valutati e celebrati ## Contatto - JW Marriott fa parte del portafoglio di marche di Marriott International e consiste di più di 100 proprietà belle in città di ingresso e località di resort distintivi in tutto il mondo - JW crede che i nostri associati vengano prima. Perché se sei felice, i nostri clienti saranno felici - JW Marriott offre un'esperienza lavorativa unica, dove sarai parte di una comunità e godrai di una vera camaraderia con un gruppo diverso di colleghi - JW crea opportunità per la formazione, lo sviluppo, il riconoscimento e soprattutto un luogo dove puoi perseguire le tue passioni in un ambiente di lusso con un focus sul benessere olistico - Trattare i clienti in modo eccezionale inizia dal modo in cui trattiamo i nostri associati. Questo è il trattamento JW™. Unendoti a JW Marriott, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marche con Marriott International. Sii dove puoi fare il tuo miglior lavoro, inizia il tuo scopo, appartieni a un team globale incredibile e diventa la miglior versione di te.

jobs.title: Hotel Cleanliness Expert
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

Marriott Hotels strive to elevate the art of hospitality, innovating at every opportunity while keeping the comfort of the oh-so-familiar all around the globe. As a host with Marriott Hotels, you will help keep the promise of “Wonderful Hospitality. Always.” by delivering thoughtful, heartfelt, forward-thinking service that upholds and builds upon this living legacy. With the name that’s synonymous with hospitality the world over, we are proud to welcome you to explore a career with Marriott Hotels. In joining Marriott Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.
 JW Marriott is part of Marriott International's luxury portfolio and consists of more than 100 beautiful properties in gateway cities and distinctive resort locations around the world. JW believes our associates come first. Because if you’re happy, our guests will be happy. JW Marriott associates are confident, innovative, genuine, intuitive, and carry on the legacy of the brand’s namesake and company founder, J.Willard Marriott. Our hotels offer a work experience unlike any other, where you’ll be part of a community and enjoy true camaraderie with a diverse group of co-workers. JW creates opportunities for training, development, recognition and most importantly, a place where you can pursue your passions in a luxury environment with a focus on holistic well-being. Treating guests exceptionally starts with the way we take care of our associates. That’s The JW Treatment™. In joining JW Marriott, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. descriptionByLocale.it: SUMMARIO POSIZIONE I nostri lavori non sono solo di dare agli ospiti una camera pulita e un letto appena fatto. Essi sono autorizzati a muoversi sul loro spazio e fare ciò che deve essere fatto. Non importa quale sia la tua posizione, ci sono alcune cose che sono critiche al successo – assicurando un luogo di lavoro sicuro, seguendo le politiche e le procedure aziendali, mantenendo la riservatezza, rispettando gli standard di qualità, e assicurando la tua uniforme, aspetto personale e le comunicazioni sono professionali. Gli esperti dell'ambiente ospite saranno in piedi e in movimento (stand, sit, o camminare per un tempo prolungato) e prendendo un approccio pratico al lavoro (move, ascensore, trasportare, spingere, tirare, e posizionare oggetti di peso inferiore o uguale a 50 libbre senza assistenza). Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile. Marriott Hotels si sforza di elevare l'arte dell'ospitalità, innovando in ogni occasione mantenendo il comfort del oh-so-familiare in tutto il mondo. Sempre.” fornendo un servizio pensieroso, sentito, in avanti che sostiene e costruisce su questa eredità vivente. Con il nome che è sinonimo di ospitalità in tutto il mondo, siamo orgogliosi di darvi il benvenuto per esplorare una carriera con Marriott Hotels. I soci JW Marriott sono fiduciosi, innovativi, genuini, intuitivi e portano avanti l’eredità dell’omonimo marchio e del fondatore della società, J.Willard Marriott. I nostri hotel offrono un'esperienza di lavoro a differenza di qualsiasi altro, dove sarete parte di una comunità e godere di vera camaraderie con un gruppo diversificato di colleghi. JW crea opportunità di formazione, sviluppo, riconoscimento e, soprattutto, un luogo in cui è possibile perseguire le vostre passioni in un ambiente di lusso con un focus sul benessere olistico. Trattare gli ospiti eccezionalmente inizia con il modo in cui ci prendiamo cura dei nostri associati. Questo è il JW TreatmentTM. Nell'unione di JW Marriott, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

ZUSAMMENFASSUNG Unsere Jobs sind nicht nur darum, den Gästen ein sauberes Zimmer und ein frisch gemachtes Bett zu geben. Unsere Gäste-Umweltexperten sind in einer Vielzahl von Haushaltsfunktionen mit Verantwortung für die Aufrechterhaltung des Aussehens und der Sauberkeit des gesamten Hotels qualifiziert. Sie sind befugt, sich um ihren Raum zu bewegen und zu tun, was getan werden muss. Ob Sie Gastanfragen, Lagerwagen, Reinigungsräume und öffentliche Räume oder andere ähnliche Verantwortlichkeiten liefern, sorgt der Guest Environment Expert dafür, dass die Räume im Hotel ein großartiges Gästeerlebnis schaffen. Egal in welcher Position Sie sich befinden, es gibt ein paar Dinge, die für den Erfolg entscheidend sind – sicherzustellen, dass ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz, nach Unternehmensrichtlinien und -verfahren, Vertraulichkeit, Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards, und sicherzustellen, dass Ihr einheitliches, persönliches Aussehen und Kommunikation sind professionell. Gäste-Umwelt-Experten werden auf ihren Füßen und bewegen sich um (Stand, sitzen, oder gehen für eine längere Zeit) und ein Hand-on-Ansatz zur Arbeit (bewegen, heben, tragen, drücken, ziehen, und stellen Gegenstände mit einem Gewicht von weniger als oder gleich 50 Pfund ohne Hilfe). Wir verpflichten uns zur Nichtdiskriminierung auf jeder geschützten Grundlage, einschließlich Behinderung, veteranischer Status oder anderer durch geltendes Recht geschützter Grundlage. Marriott Hotels bemühen sich, die Kunst der Gastfreundschaft zu erhöhen, innovieren bei jeder Gelegenheit, während der Komfort der oh-so-familiar auf der ganzen Welt. Als Gastgeber bei Marriott Hotels helfen Sie, das Versprechen von “Wunderbare Hospitality. Immer.“ durch die Bereitstellung von nachdenklichem, herzhaftem, vorausdenkendem Dienst, der auf diesem lebendigen Erbe aufrechterhält und baut. Mit dem Namen, der für die Gastfreundschaft der ganzen Welt synonym ist, sind wir stolz, Sie zu begrüßen, um eine Karriere mit Marriott Hotels zu erkunden. I nostri Esperti di Eventi per Ospiti sono competenti in un'ampia gamma di attività legate agli eventi e sono responsabili dell'esecuzione impeccabile dell'evento dalla A alla Z. Marriott Hotels si impegna a elevare l'arte dell'ospitalità, innovando a ogni occasione pur mantenendo il comfort di ciò che è familiare in ogni parte del mondo. In qualità di ospite di Marriott Hotels, contribuirai a mantenere la promessa di «Wonderful Hospitality. Always.» offrendo un servizio attento, sincero e lungimirante che rispetti e arricchisca questo patrimonio vivente. jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

At more than 100 award-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.
Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.

In joining The Ritz-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione SUMMARIO POSIZIONE I nostri lavori non sono solo di dare agli ospiti una camera pulita e un letto appena fatto. Invece, vogliamo costruire un'esperienza indimenticabile e unica. I nostri esperti per l'ambiente ospite sono esperti in una vasta gamma di funzioni di pulizia con la responsabilità di mantenere l'aspetto e la pulizia di tutto l'hotel. Essi sono autorizzati a muoversi sul loro spazio e fare ciò che deve essere fatto. Che si tratti di fornire richieste agli ospiti, carrelli di stoccaggio, camere di pulizia e spazi pubblici, o altre responsabilità simili, il Guest Environment Expert assicura che gli spazi dell'hotel contribuiscono a creare una grande esperienza di ospiti. Non importa quale sia la tua posizione, ci sono alcune cose che sono critiche al successo – assicurando un luogo di lavoro sicuro, seguendo le politiche e le procedure aziendali, mantenendo la riservatezza, rispettando gli standard di qualità, e assicurando la tua uniforme, aspetto personale e le comunicazioni sono professionali. Gli esperti dell'ambiente ospite saranno in piedi e in movimento (stand, sit, o camminare per un tempo prolungato) e prendendo un approccio pratico al lavoro (move, ascensore, trasportare, spingere, tirare, e posizionare oggetti di peso inferiore o uguale a 50 libbre senza assistenza). Fare tutte queste cose bene (e altri ragionevoli doveri di lavoro come richiesto) è fondamentale per gli esperti di ambiente degli ospiti - per ottenere il diritto per i nostri ospiti e la nostra attività ogni volta. A Marriott International, siamo dedicati ad essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità, accogliendo tutti e fornendo l'accesso alle opportunità. Promuoviamo attivamente un ambiente in cui gli sfondi unici dei nostri associati sono apprezzati e celebrati. La nostra più grande forza risiede nella ricca miscela di cultura, talento ed esperienze dei nostri associati. Ci impegniamo a non discriminazione su base protetta, tra cui disabilità, status di veterano, o altre basi protette dalla legge applicabile. In oltre 100 strutture premiate in tutto il mondo, The Ritz-Carlton Signore e Signori creano esperienze così eccezionali che a lungo dopo un ospite soggiorna con noi, l'esperienza rimane con loro. Attrarre i migliori professionisti dell’ospitalità del mondo che curano i ricordi per tutta la vita, crediamo che tutti ci riescano quando hanno il potere di essere creativi, riflessivi e compassionevoli. Ogni giorno, abbiamo stabilito lo standard per il servizio di lusso raro e speciale in tutto il mondo e ci orgogliosi di fornire l'eccellenza nella cura e nel comfort dei nostri ospiti. Il vostro ruolo sarà quello di garantire che i “Gold Standards” di The Ritz-Carlton vengano consegnati con gentilezza e con pensiero ogni giorno. Gli Gold Standards sono la base di The Ritz-Carlton e sono ciò che ci guida ogni giorno per essere meglio del prossimo. E 'questa fondazione e la nostra convinzione che la nostra cultura spinge il successo con cui The Ritz Carlton ha guadagnato la reputazione di leader di marca globale nell'ospitalità di lusso. Nell'ambito del nostro team, imparerai ed esemplificherai gli standard dell'oro, come la nostra promessa dei dipendenti, il credo e i nostri valori di servizio. E la nostra promessa è che offriamo la possibilità di essere orgogliosi del lavoro che fate e con cui lavorate. Nell'unione con The Ritz-Carlton, ti unisci a un portafoglio di marchi con Marriott International. Essere dove si può fare il vostro lavoro migliore, iniziare il vostro scopo, appartengono a un team globale incredibile, e diventare la migliore versione di voi.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Beschreibung ZUSAMMENFASSUNG Unsere Jobs sind nicht nur darum, den Gästen ein sauberes Zimmer und ein frisch gemachtes Bett zu geben. Stattdessen wollen wir eine Erfahrung aufbauen, die unvergesslich und einzigartig ist. Unsere Gäste-Umweltexperten sind in einer Vielzahl von Haushaltsfunktionen mit Verantwortung für die Aufrechterhaltung des Aussehens und der Sauberkeit des gesamten Hotels qualifiziert. Sie sind befugt, sich um ihren Raum zu bewegen und zu tun, was getan werden muss. Ob Sie Gastanfragen, Lagerwagen, Reinigungsräume und öffentliche Räume oder andere ähnliche Verantwortlichkeiten liefern, sorgt der Guest Environment Expert dafür, dass die Räume im Hotel ein großartiges Gästeerlebnis schaffen. Egal in welcher Position Sie sich befinden, es gibt ein paar Dinge, die für den Erfolg entscheidend sind – sicherzustellen, dass ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz, nach Unternehmensrichtlinien und -verfahren, Vertraulichkeit, Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards, und sicherzustellen, dass Ihr einheitliches, persönliches Aussehen und Kommunikation sind professionell. Gäste-Umwelt-Experten werden auf ihren Füßen und bewegen sich um (Stand, sitzen, oder gehen für eine längere Zeit) und ein Hand-on-Ansatz zur Arbeit (bewegen, heben, tragen, drücken, ziehen, und stellen Gegenstände mit einem Gewicht von weniger als oder gleich 50 Pfund ohne Hilfe). All diese Dinge gut zu tun (und andere vernünftige
• Aufgaben wie gewünscht) ist für Gäste-Umwelt-Experten kritisch – um es für unsere Gäste und unser Geschäft jedes Mal richtig zu bekommen. Bei Marriott International widmen wir uns als Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit, begrüßen alle und bieten Zugang zur Gelegenheit. Wir fördern aktiv eine Umgebung, in der die einzigartigen Hintergründe unserer Mitarbeiter geschätzt und gefeiert werden. Unsere größte Stärke liegt in der reichen Mischung aus Kultur, Talent und Erfahrungen unserer Mitarbeiter. Wir verpflichten uns zur Nichtdiskriminierung auf jeder geschützten Grundlage, einschließlich Behinderung, veteranischer Status oder anderer durch geltendes Recht geschützter Grundlage. Bei mehr als 100 preisgekrönten Unterkünften weltweit schaffen die Ritz-Carlton Damen und Herren so außergewöhnliche Erlebnisse, dass die Erfahrung nach einem Gast bei uns bleibt. Anziehen der weltweit besten Gastfreundschaft Profis, die lebenslange Erinnerungen heilen, glauben wir, dass jeder Erfolg hat, wenn sie befähigt sind, kreativ, nachdenklich und mitfühlend zu sein. Jeden Tag setzen wir den Standard für den seltenen und besonderen Luxus-Service der Welt und stolz uns auf die Bereitstellung von Exzellenz in der Pflege und dem Komfort unserer Gäste. Ihre Aufgabe wird es sein, sicherzustellen, dass die „Goldstandards“ von The Ritz-Carlton jeden Tag gnädig und nachdenklich geliefert werden. Die Goldstandards sind die Grundlage von The Ritz-Carlton und sind das, was uns jeden Tag besser als der nächste führt. Es ist diese Grundlage und unser Glaube, dass unsere Kultur Erfolg treibt, durch die die Ritz Carlton den Ruf als globaler Markenführer in der Luxus-Hospitalität verdient hat. Im Rahmen unseres Teams lernen und exemplifizieren Sie die Gold-Standards, wie unsere Employee Promise, Credo und unsere Service-Werte. Und unser Versprechen an Sie ist, dass wir die Chance bieten, stolz auf die Arbeit zu sein, mit der Sie arbeiten. Bei der Teilnahme an The Ritz-Carlton nehmen Sie mit Marriott International ein Portfolio an Marken bei. Seien Sie, wo Sie Ihre beste Arbeit tun können, beginnen Sie Ihren Zweck, gehören zu einem erstaunlichen globalen Team und werden die beste Version von Ihnen.

Les experts de l'environnement invités seront sur leurs pieds et se déplaceront (s'asseoir, s'asseoir ou marcher pendant un temps prolongé) et adopteront une approche pratique du travail (déplacer, soulever, porter, pousser, tirer et placer des objets pesant moins de 50 livres sans assistance). Faire toutes ces choses bien (et d'autres tâches d'emploi raisonnables comme demandé) est essentiel pour les experts de l'environnement invités – pour l'obtenir pour nos invités et nos affaires à chaque fois. Chez Marriott International, nous nous engageons à être un employeur à égalité des chances, accueillant tous et offrant l'accès aux possibilités. Nous favorisons activement un environnement où les origines uniques de nos associés sont appréciées et célébrées. Notre plus grande force réside dans le riche mélange de culture, de talent et d'expériences de nos associés. Nous sommes attachés à la non-discrimination sur toute base protégée, y compris le handicap, le statut d'ancien combattant ou toute autre base protégée par la loi applicable. Dans plus de 100 établissements primés dans le monde entier, les Dames et Messieurs Ritz-Carlton créent des expériences si exceptionnelles qu'après qu'un invité reste avec nous, l'expérience reste avec eux. Attirer le monde des meilleurs professionnels de l'hôtellerie qui s'occupent des souvenirs de toute une vie, nous croyons que tout le monde réussit quand il est habilité à être créatif, réfléchi et compatissant. Chaque jour, nous établissons la norme pour un service de luxe rare et spécial dans le monde entier et nous sommes fiers d'offrir l'excellence dans le soin et le confort de nos clients. Votre rôle sera de veiller à ce que les normes d'or du Ritz-Carlton soient délivrées gracieusement et avec soin chaque jour. Les Standards d'or sont la fondation du Ritz-Carlton et sont ce qui nous guide chaque jour à être meilleurs que le suivant. C'est cette fondation et notre conviction que notre culture est à l'origine du succès grâce auquel The Ritz Carlton a acquis la réputation de leader mondial en matière d'hospitalité de luxe. Dans le cadre de notre équipe, vous apprendrez et illustrerez les normes d'or, comme notre promesse d'employé, Credo et nos valeurs de service. Et notre promesse est que nous offrons la chance d'être fiers du travail que vous faites et avec qui vous travaillez. En rejoignant The Ritz-Carlton, vous rejoignez un portefeuille de marques avec Marriott International. Soyez là où vous pouvez faire votre meilleur travail, commencer votre objectif, appartenir à une équipe mondiale incroyable, et devenir la meilleure version de vous.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

We are looking for a creative, proactive and team-spirited ½ Chef de Partie to join the kitchen team of our venues, where refined techniques meet bold, flavorful cuisine.

This is your chance to be part of a restaurant concept that comes alive , a space where culinary artistry, ambiance and lifestyle converge to deliver a premium, high-energy dining experience in the heart of the Swiss Alps.

YOUR ROLE

Assist the Chef de Partie and kitchen leadership in the service operations, from prep to plating.

Execute dishes with precision, creativity, and consistency according to 5-star culinary standards.

Contribute to the identity of the venues by embracing their concepts and unique storytelling.

Maintain strict hygiene and cleanliness standards in accordance with HACCP and internal procedures.

Be proactive in your approach, from anticipating needs in the kitchen to suggesting fresh ideas.

Collaborate closely with your teammates, demonstrating flexibility, professionalism, and team spirit in a fast-paced service environment.

PROFILE

You have a true passion for cooking and attention to detail, especially in a fine dining dinner setting.

You enjoy the rhythm and energy of evening service, and know how to stay sharp and inspired from start to finish.

You bring a positive, can-do attitude and value cleanliness, organization, and collaboration.

You’re eager to grow within a creative and supportive team under the iconic W brand.

If you’re ready to light up the night with flavor, flair, and finesse, we want to hear from you.

Bring your creativity to the kitchen. Be the taste. Be the experience. Be W.

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions only applicants from Switzerland and European Union can be considered.

We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. descriptionByLocale.it: DESCRIZIONE DELLA JOB Diventa un talento W e incarna l'arte W di vivere! Come ‘Talent’, siete l’essenza di W per i nostri ospiti. Porti un tocco giocoso, caldo e accogliente che fa la differenza nei nostri hotel W. Siete unici, appassionati e la vostra personalità brilla in ogni interazione. UNA OPPORTUNITÀ ESEPIZIONALE PER IL TEAM VERBIER W! Siamo alla ricerca di un creativo, proattivo e team-spirited 1⁄2 Chef de Partie per unirsi al team di cucina delle nostre sedi, dove le tecniche raffinate incontrano cucina audace e saporita. Questa è la tua occasione per far parte di un concetto di ristorante che si anima, uno spazio in cui l'arte culinaria, l'atmosfera e lo stile di vita convergono per offrire un'esperienza culinaria premium e ad alta energia nel cuore delle Alpi svizzere. Il tuo! Assistere lo Chef de Partie e la leadership di cucina nelle operazioni di servizio, dalla preparazione alla placcatura. Eseguire piatti con precisione, creatività e consistenza secondo gli standard culinari a 5 stelle. Contribuisci all'identità dei luoghi abbracciando i loro concetti e la narrazione unica. Mantenere rigidi standard di igiene e pulizia in conformità con HACCP e procedure interne. Sii proattivo nel tuo approccio, dall'anticipazione delle esigenze in cucina a suggerire idee fresche. Collabora a stretto contatto con i tuoi compagni di squadra, dimostrando flessibilità, professionalità e spirito di squadra in un ambiente di servizio veloce. PROFESSIONALE Hai una vera passione per la cucina e l'attenzione ai dettagli, soprattutto in un ambiente di cena raffinata. Vi piace il ritmo e l'energia del servizio serale, e sapere come rimanere affilato e ispirato dall'inizio alla fine. Porti un atteggiamento positivo, can-do e la pulizia del valore, l'organizzazione e la collaborazione. jobs.title: Commis de Cuisine Banquets
jobs.description:
REQUIREMENTS
 CH/ EU CITIZENS ONLY

POSITION SUMMARY

Prepare special meals or substitute items. Regulate temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Pull food from freezer storage to thaw in the refrigerator. Ensure proper portion, arrangement, and food garnish. Maintain food logs. Monitor the quality and quantity of food that is prepared. Communicate assistance needed during busy periods. Inform Chef of excess food items for use in daily specials. Inform Food & Beverage service staff of menu specials and out of stock menu items. Ensure the quality of the food items. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods.

Assist management in hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating and coaching employees; serve as a role model. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Anticipate and address guests’ service needs. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION
 • Education: Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree.
 • Related Work Experience: At least 3 years of related work experience.
 • Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.
 • License or Certification: None

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

A UNIQUE OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM

As part of our team, you will take orders and serve guests in a cheerful, enthusiastic, professional and meticulous manner.

As an In-Room-Dining (Room-Service) Chef de Rang, you will join our afternoon/evening team . You will be responsible for taking orders to guests, preparing table settings, returning finished meals, as well as checking room mixbars. You will work nights to help ensure a quality service at all times of the day.

You will ensure that orders are ready on time and respond to the various requests of your Talent Coach.

PROFILE

Outgoing, cheerful, good listener, passionate and available.

Enjoys working at night

Fluent in French and English

Enjoy working in an international and adventurous team

Excellent presentation and representative of the W brand image

BAC PRO//CFC// BTS Restauration or 2 years in a similar position

You are highly motivated

Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance

You have great attention to detail and are passionate about delivering a memorable customer experience

Position to be filled for the Winter season : December 2026 to March 2027

Due to visa restrictions, only applications from Switzerland and the European Union will be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

• In uscita, dinamica, attenta ed empatica.
• Fluente in francese e inglese. La conoscenza delle lingue aggiuntive è un plus.

• Presentazione impeccabile, riflettendo l'immagine e i valori del marchio W.

En rejoignant W Hotels, vous rejoignez un portefeuille de marques avec Marriott International. jobs.title: B&F Intern (July - 6 months) - W VERBIER
jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Become a W Talent and Embody the W Art of Living!

As a ‘Talent’, you are the essence of W for our guests. You bring a playful, warm and welcoming touch that makes all the difference in our W hotels. You are unique, passionate, and your personality shines through in every interaction.

AN EXCEPTIONAL OPPORTUNITY TO JOIN THE W VERBIER TEAM!

To build up a strong experience in F&B operations, you will join our multi-skilled team as B&F Intern . You'll learn first-hand about hotel operations. Our hotel internship program allows you to experience the industry from the ground up

During your internship you will be in charge of :

- Ensure service standards

- Responsible for F&B service quality and customer satisfaction

- Ensure smooth collaboration between service and kitchen

- Help your team maintain the cleanliness of the various outlets and customer areas

- Help your team take and serve customer orders

- Collect orders and requisitions

- Welcoming and placing customers

- Ability to make appropriate recommendations based on customer preferences

- Ensure customer loyalty by offering friendly service

- Ensure smooth service and communication between kitchen and restaurant

- Ensure smooth flow of information between hotel departments

You will ensure that orders are ready on time and respond to the various requests of your Talent Coach.

PROFILE

- Must be currently enrolled in a Hospitality school

- Outgoing, playful, sociable, good listener, helpful and available

- Enjoy working in an international and audacious team

- Excellent presentation and representative of the W brand image

- You are highly motivated

- Excellent customer contact

- Fluency in foreign languages (English, German and others are an asset)

- Organized, conscientious, punctual

- Excellent knowledge of the hotel's various departments

Real interest in the worlds of taste, sound, body, scene and stance

You have great attention to detail and are passionate about delivering a memorable customer experience

Internship starting in June/July 2026 for 6 months

Due to visa restrictions only applicants from Switzerland and European Union can be considered.

At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.

W Hotels’ mission is to Ignite Curiosity, Expand Worlds. We are a place to experience life. We’re here to open doors and open minds. We are constantly inspired by new faces and new experiences. A tuned-in, up-for-anything spirit is at our core and has made us renowned for reinventing the norms of luxury around the globe. Whatever/Whenever is our culture and service philosophy that brings our guests’ passions to life. If you are original, innovative, and always looking towards the future of what’s possible, welcome to W Hotels. In joining W Hotels, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work,​ begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global​ team, and become the best version of you.

jobs.description:
Serve food courses and alcoholic beverages to guests. Set tables according to type of event and service standards. Answer questions on menu selections. Communicate with the kitchen regarding menu questions, the length of wait, re-cook orders, and product availability. Communicate additional meal requirements, allergies, dietary needs, and special requests to the kitchen. Record transaction in MICROS system at time of order. Check in with guests to ensure satisfaction with each food course and/or beverages. Maintain cleanliness of work areas, china, glass, etc., throughout the day. Complete closing duties, including restocking items, turning off lights, etc. Present physical and accurate check to guest and process payment.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests’ service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and objects weighing in excess of 50 pounds with assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
